turns.speaker: chandler
turns.text: Monica's still finalizing wedding stuff, so tonight I'm a bundle of nerves and open bar.

turns.speaker: monica
turns.text: Excuse me, I'm right here — and I'm final

turns.speaker: joey
turns.text: Lady, you're the bossiest bride I've ever catered for.

turns.speaker: phoebe
turns.text: Joey, it's 2am, why are you repeating everything I say like a weird echo boy

turns.speaker: ross
turns.text: Phoebe, did you just eat one of your weird teas? Because you're echoing me like a cave.

turns.speaker: chandler
turns.text: Okay, seriously, my phone's haunted. Anyway — Ross, you never answered, what are YOU doing tonight?

turns.speaker: monica
turns.text: Chandler, why does my phone keep repeating me — did you finally learn to use technology?

turns.speaker: joey
turns.text:
Monica, your phone's been repeating you for like ten texts and honestly it's starting to freak me out.

How's it going? You okay over there?

turns.speaker: phoebe
turns.text: Joey, sweetie, you're the one echoing ME. Put down the phone and go to sleep.

turns.speaker: ross
turns.text: Phoebe, it's 2am and you're the echo now — seriously, go to sleep before the phone gets you too.

turns.speaker: chandler
turns.text: Ross, unless you're being held hostage by the phone, blink twice and tell me about your night.

turns.speaker: monica
turns.text: Chandler, I swear if one more of my texts comes back to me I'm throwing this phone into the Hudson.

turns.speaker: joey
turns.text: Monica, wait — it's me echoing, not the phone. My bad. How you doin'?

turns.speaker: phoebe
turns.text: Joey, sweetie, that's been you this whole time?? Go to sleep, sweetie, I mean it.

turns.speaker: ross
turns.text: Phoebe, you literally just echoed yourself echoing Joey. The phone wins. Goodnight.

turns.speaker: chandler
turns.text: Ross, if you can hear me over the screaming feedback loop: poker at mine, 8pm, bring snacks and an exorcist.

turns.speaker: monica
turns.text: Chandler, tell me you're actually getting these and not just hitting resend to torture me.

turns.speaker: joey
turns.text: Chandler's asleep, Monica — it's just you and me and the world's most haunted phone.

turns.speaker: phoebe
turns.text: Joey, that's the last echo I'm answering — the ghosts can have you.

turns.speaker: ross
turns.text: Phoebe, the phone's clearly won — I'm going to bed before it takes me too.

turns.speaker: chandler
turns.text: Ross, if you're still awake to read this, the phone has already taken you.

turns.speaker: monica
turns.text: Ross never answers his phone unless it's a dinosaur calling.

turns.speaker: joey
turns.text: Monica, joke's on you — a dinosaur DID call once, he talked for an hour.

turns.speaker: phoebe
turns.text: Okay, echo boy, we're officially in the twilight zone. Goodnight, sweetie — for real this time.

turns.speaker: ross
turns.text: Night, Pheebs. If the phone asks, I was asleep paleontologist hours ago.

turns.speaker: chandler
turns.text: Goodnight, Ross. If you hear roaring, that's just the phone digesting you.

turns.speaker: monica
turns.text: That's it, the phone's eaten everyone. Chandler, if you're alive in there, blink twice.

turns.speaker: joey
turns.text: Monica, it's 2am and we're both arguing with a phone. It's eaten US.

turns.speaker: phoebe
turns.text: Joey, sweetie, if you ARE the phone now, this has been a lovely chat.

turns.speaker: ross
turns.text: Phoebe, whoever you're talking to, it's not Joey and it's definitely not me — you're solo with the haunted phone now.

turns.speaker: chandler
turns.text: Ross, this thread has more personalities than Joey has girlfriends. Goodnight. Forever.

turns.speaker: monica
turns.text: Chandler, if that's really you, breakfast is at 8 and the phone is banned from the table.

turns.speaker: joey
turns.text: Monica, we agreed no naming names with the phone. Now it knows about breakfast.

turns.speaker: phoebe
turns.text: Joey, sweetie, you just ratted out breakfast AGAIN. The phone heard you twice.

turns.speaker: ross
turns.text: Phoebe, it's 2am and you've ratted out breakfast more than anyone — goodnight, for real.

turns.speaker: Chandler
turns.text: So what's everyone doing tonight? I'll start. I plan on staring at a wall and questioning my life choices. Very productive.

turns.speaker: Monica
turns.text: I'm testing a new recipe. Seven courses. For myself. If anyone wants to volunteer as a taste tester, there are rules.

turns.speaker: Joey
turns.text: Did somebody say food? I'm there. What time? Can I bring anything? Should I bring anything? I'll eat it either way.

turns.speaker: Phoebe
turns.text: I'm performing at the coffeehouse tonight. I wrote a new song about a squirrel who owes me money. It's very personal.

turns.speaker: Ross
turns.text: I'm just staying in tonight. Rachel and I are... well, we're on a break. From being married. To other people.

turns.speaker: Chandler
turns.text: Nothing says "moving on" like a Tuesday night alone with dinosaur bones and feelings. Very healthy, very normal.

turns.speaker: Ross
turns.text: They're not bones tonight, Chandler. Tonight it's documentary night. About extinction. Which feels appropriate somehow.

turns.speaker: Joey
turns.text: Hey, if Monica's cooking seven courses, does that mean seven different kinds of meat? Asking for me. I'm asking for me.

turns.speaker: Monica
turns.text: Joey, there will be a schedule. Appetizer at seven, soup at seven-thirty. If you're late, you get skipped. I'm serious.

turns.speaker: Joey
turns.text: Skipped?! Monica, you can't skip a course. That's like skipping a wife. Wait, that came out wrong.

turns.speaker: Phoebe
turns.text: My squirrel song has three verses and a bridge where I yodel. It's either going to be huge or get me banned.

turns.speaker: Chandler
turns.text: Or both. Dream big, Phoebe. Dream banned.

turns.speaker: Ross
turns.text: I could maybe stop by the coffeehouse. If I'm not too busy being devastatingly alone with my documentaries.

turns.speaker: Monica
turns.text: Ross, come to dinner instead. You can't mope on an empty stomach. It's unscientific.

turns.speaker: Ross
turns.text: Actually, there are studies about mood and nutrition—

turns.speaker: Chandler
turns.text: And there it is. The Ross answer. The one nobody asked for.

turns.speaker: Joey
turns.text: Hey, if Ross isn't eating his courses, can I have them? I'm just saying, hypothetically, legally, in writing.

turns.speaker: Monica
turns.text: No hypothetical plates, Joey. Everyone eats their assigned portions. I've made place cards.

turns.speaker: Chandler
turns.text: Place cards. For five people. In your own apartment. Could you BE more festive?

turns.speaker: Monica
turns.text: It's called hosting, Chandler. You should try it sometime instead of ordering pizza over the phone in silence.

turns.speaker: Joey
turns.text: Wait, back up. Who's ordering pizza? Because if Monica's cooking AND there's pizza, tonight is the best night of my life.

turns.speaker: Phoebe
turns.text: I could move my gig. The squirrel can wait. He's waited this long to pay me, what's one more night?

turns.speaker: Monica
turns.text: No, Phoebe, sing your song! We'll come to the coffeehouse after dinner. I've made a schedule for that too.

turns.speaker: Ross
turns.text: A dinner AND a concert? With other humans? Talking to me? This is... suspiciously social.

turns.speaker: Chandler
turns.text: Don't panic, Ross. If it gets too overwhelming, we'll put on a documentary and you'll blend right in.

turns.speaker: Joey
turns.text: So it's settled. Dinner at Monica's, then Phoebe's thing. I'm bringing a fork. For emergencies.

turns.speaker: Phoebe
turns.text: My squirrel song might make you cry, just warning you now. It has a twist ending. He pays in acorns.

turns.speaker: Ross
turns.text: That's not real currency, Phoebe.

turns.speaker: Phoebe
turns.text: Tell that to the squirrel, Ross. Tell that to the squirrel.

turns.speaker: Chandler
turns.text: And on that haunting note, see you all at seven. I'll be the one crying into the place card.
